The Property

Contemporary Townhouse
in Sought-After Findon

Perfectly positioned within a well-maintained group at 35 Rondo Avenue, this beautifully presented two-storey townhouse offers modern, low-maintenance living in one of Adelaide's most convenient western suburbs.

Light-filled and spacious, the ground floor features a generous open-plan living and dining area with floating timber floors, flowing seamlessly through sliding doors to a private, landscaped rear courtyard — perfect for year-round entertaining.

Upstairs, three well-sized bedrooms all with built-in robes, master with private ensuite and balcony, plus a second living retreat — ideal for families, professionals or investors.
